messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: RStan suport for RStudio?
parts:
RStan's not working for at least one Mac user
under RStudio. Has anyone gotten RStan working
in any version of RStudio? On Mac OS X?

The issue at hand is whether RStan should support
RStudio. It's not part of either Stan or RStan,
so the answer can conceivably be "no".

Option 1: leave it up to users.

Option 2: figure out the current user problem,
test future releases against RStudio, and provide
install instructions if they're non-trivial.

I have no idea how widepspread RStudio use is,
but it should be part of our decision, along with
how easy/hard it would be for users to switch back
and forth between RStudio and R in the terminal or
R GUI.

I don't personally use IDEs for (at least) three reasons:
(a) they're just one more thing to misconfigure in
the tool chain, and (b) they're hard to script,
and (c) I'd rather type than point and click.

For now, I'm going to put the issue with RStan into
our issue tracker, but I'll leave it to others to
solve. We can discuss whether we want to support
RStudio at the Stan meeting tomorrow.

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: RStan suport for RStudio?
parts:
On Monday, September 24, 2012 5:30:13 PM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
RStan's not working for at least one Mac user
under RStudio.  Has anyone gotten RStan working
in any version of RStudio?  On Mac OS X?
Yes, RStan works for me in RStudio, but that is Linux with 64 bit everything.

The issue at hand is whether RStan should support
RStudio.  It's not part of either Stan or RStan,
so the answer can conceivably be "no".

   Option 1:  leave it up to users.

   Option 2:  figure out the current user problem,
      test future releases against RStudio, and provide
      install instructions if they're non-trivial.

I have no idea how widepspread RStudio use is,

but it should be part of our decision, along with
how easy/hard it would be for users to switch back
and forth between RStudio and R in the terminal or
R GUI.

Worst case, you can write R code in the top RStudio window and copy / paste it to an R session in a shell.

I think we should try to sort it out, but I feel that this is more of a RStudio problem than a RStan problem, in the sense that I think the RStudio guys would consider it a bug for a package to work in an R GUI or an R session in a shell but not in RStudio.

Ben
